pkgTitle: Certificate derivative check at very small or zero flows (merged)
title: Q-WIT-2: correct one outdated sentence in the flash model's description
body: With the fixed derivative check, an ammonia flash state near its dew point now verifies honestly, so the "near-dew window" sentence in the `c1.tp_flash` model's manifest text (`src/openflowsheet/models/c1/flash.py:343-349`) states an outdated edge.
Correcting it changes that model's artifact hash and one frozen identity-corpus entry (F0 M9), but not its `model_version` or any result.

options.label: Yes, correct it
options.detail: In its own commit, with the corpus entry re-recorded.

options.label: No, leave the sentence
options.detail: The stale edge stays documented as a known inaccuracy.
